categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes input validation in `src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp` and adds functional test in `test/functional/wallet_sendall.py` with Wallet label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where passing duplicate inputs to `sendall` constructs a consensus-invalid transaction that locks UTXOs and causes negative balances until manually abandoned. While triggered only when callers explicitly pass duplicate outpoints via RPC, rejecting the input early prevents local wallet state corruption.
